english: In hot weather, water evaporates from the leaves faster than the roots can pull moisture from the soil. Applying a layer of organic mulch around the plants keeps the soil cool and moist throughout the afternoon heat.
ga: yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ mli Nu shwieɔ shi kɛjɛɔ baai amli oya fe bɔ ni shishifãi baanyɛ ajie ŋmɔtɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Layer organic mulch kɛbɔle he. Tsei lɛ baaye abua ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee fɛ̃i ni edɔ yɛ shwane muu lɛ fɛɛ mli.

english: How long should I wait for my seeds to sprout after planting them in the dirt?
ga: Be enyiɛ esa akɛ mamɛ dumɔwui lɛ ni amɛkwɛ̃ beni midu amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ mli sɛɛ?

english: Most crop seeds like maize, beans, or vegetables will sprout within 4 to 10 days if the soil has enough moisture and heat; if nothing shows up after two weeks, the seeds may have rotted or been eaten by insects.
ga: Dumɔwui babaoo, tamɔ ŋmãa, ŋmãa, loo aduawai, baakwɛ̃ yɛ gbii 4 kɛyashi 10 mli kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ nu kɛ dɔlɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa. Kɛji nɔ ko ejeee kpo yɛ otsii enyɔ sɛɛ Dumɔwui lɛ baanyɛ agbo loo kooloi baanyɛ aye amɛ.

english: Should I plant my crop seeds right after the very first rain of the season?
ga: Ani esa akɛ madu dumɔwui yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ yɛ be lɛ mli lɛ sɛɛ nɔŋŋ?

english: It is usually better to wait for two or three steady rains before planting, because planting after just one early rain can cause your seeds to dry up and burn if a long dry spell follows immediately.
ga: Taakɛ eji lɛ, esa akɛ omɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ 2-3 ni nyiɛɔ sɛɛ dani oduɔ nii. Ejaakɛ kɛ́ adu shikome pɛ yɛ leebi nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ eha dumɔwui lɛ agbi ni amɛshã kɛji hɔmɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ nyiɛ sɛɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ.

english: Yellow leaves on young maize usually mean the plants lack nitrogen in the soil or are getting too much water, which starves the roots of air and essential nutrients.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa bibii anɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ bɛ nitrogen yɛ sũ lɛ mli loo enine shɛɔ nu babaoo nɔ. Enɛ haaa kɔɔyɔɔ ni he hiaa kɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ nibii ni he hiaa ni yɔɔ shishifãi lɛ amli lɛ.

english: Why is it bad if I plant my crops too close to each other on my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehiii kɛji midu ŋmɔshi nibii ni bɛŋkɛ mihe tsɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Planting too close forces crops to fight each other for sunlight, water, and soil nutrients, causing them to grow tall and thin while producing very small harvests.
ga: Dumɔ ni bɛŋkɛ tsɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ esa akɛ tso lɛ atswa hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ feɔ kukuji ni amɛfeɔ kukuji yɛ be mli ni amɛwoɔ yibii fioo ko pɛ.

english: Why do my crops dry up and wither even when it rained just a few days ago?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ midumɔ nii lɛ miiho lɛ? Ni nugbɔ nɛ gbii fioo komɛi ni eho nɛ?

english: Sandy soil or shallow ground cannot hold water for long, so sun heat quickly evaporates moisture from the root level, leaving the plants thirsty shortly after rain.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni ŋã yɔɔ nɔ loo shikpɔŋ ni mli ekwɔɔɔ lɛ nyɛŋ ahi nu mli be kakadaŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, la ni jɛɔ hulu lɛ mli lɛ haa ŋmɔtɔ ni yɔɔ shishifã lɛ mli lɛ shwieɔ shi oya. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, kɛ́ nugbɔ enɛ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, kumai yeɔ tsei.

english: Why do my maize stalks fall over easily whenever a small wind blows?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa tsei lɛ gbeeɔ shi oya kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ fioo ko tswa lɛ?

english: Stalks fall over when roots are shallow, which happens if seeds were planted too close to the surface, or if underground insects have eaten and damaged the roots.
ga: Tso lɛ baagbee shi kɛji shishifãi lɛ mli ekɔɔɔ. Enɛ baa mli kɛji akɛ adu dumɔwui lɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ tsɔ. Aloo kɛji shikpɔŋ shishi kooloi ye ni amɛfite shishifãi lɛ.

english: What causes a maize plant to grow tall but produce very small cobs with missing grains?
ga: Mɛni haa ŋmãa tsei lɛ daraa shi amɛheɔ ŋmeii bibii waa ni ŋmeii lɛ bɛ mli?

english: Poor cob development usually happens when there is a dry spell during the flowering stage, or because the plants did not get enough food from the soil during their early growth.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, cob lɛ shweremɔ ni ehiii lɛ baa kɛji be ko yɛ ni hulu lɛ enyɔ shi yɛ fɔfɔii afeemɔ be mli. aloo akɛni tso lɛ nine shɛɛɛ niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa nɔ kɛjɛɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ shishijee be mli ni edara lɛ hewɔ.

english: Pepper plants drop their flowers when they experience extreme heat, lack of water, or too much nitrogen fertilizer, which makes the plant focus on growing leaves instead of fruit.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ hulutsoo be ni naa wa, nu ni bɛ, loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo wo mli. Enɛ haa tso lɛ kɛ ejwɛŋmɔ maa baai ni miida lɛ nɔ moŋ fe aduawai.

english: Why are holes suddenly appearing in the middle leaves of my young maize plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ buji eje kpo trukaa yɛ mi-ŋmei bibii lɛ ateŋ baai lɛ amli lɛ?

english: Holes in young maize leaves are typically caused by fall armyworms or caterpillars eating the soft center of the plant, which can destroy the crop if not treated quickly.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, fall armyworms loo ŋmeii ni yeɔ tso lɛ hei ni yɔɔ blɛoo lɛ anɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ bu ni yɔɔ ŋmãa baai bibii amli lɛ baa. Enɛ baanyɛ afite ŋmɔshi nibii kɛji akɛ atsuuu he nii oya.

english: Is it good for my farm if I grow cassava and maize on the same piece of land together?
ga: Ani ehi kɛha miŋmɔ lɛ kɛji mikɛ ŋmãa kɛ ŋmãa fee ekome yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ?

english: Yes, growing them together works well because maize grows quickly and is harvested early, leaving space and sunlight for the slower-growing cassava to expand later.
ga: Hɛɛ, kɛ́ akɛ amɛ fee ekome lɛ, etsuɔ ​​nii jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ ŋmãa daa oya, ni akpaa lɛ mra. Shi he ko kɛ hulu la kɛha ŋmei ni daa blɛoo lɛ koni egbɛ eshwa sɛɛ mli.

english: Young cocoa seedlings are tender and burn under direct sunlight. Planting temporary shade crops like plantains alongside young cocoa gives them the shade and soil moisture they need to grow strong.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ blɛoo ni amɛshãa yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ shishi. Be kukuoo mli hulutsoo tsei tamɔ plantains ni aduɔ yɛ kookoo bibii ahe lɛ haa tsei lɛ hulutsoo kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ nu ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why do my maize leaves have holes in them and look like caterpillars are eating the center?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi ŋmãa baa lɛ yɛ bu ni etamɔ nɔ ni ŋmeii miiye teŋgbɛ lɛ?

english: This damage is usually caused by the Fall Armyworm, a pest that hides in the middle of maize plants. Applying recommended treatments early into the crop's growth protects the leaves and protects your yield.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, Fall Armyworm, ni ji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni kɛ ehe woɔ ŋmãa tsei ateŋ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. Tsofai ni atsɔɔ akɛ akɛtsuɔ nii mra Yɛ tsei adalɛ mli lɛ, ebuɔ baai lɛ ahe ni ebuɔ onibii ahe.

english: Why shouldn't I plant my rice seeds too close to each other in the field?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miduɔ ŋmãa dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛɔ amɛhe tsɔ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: When rice seeds are planted too closely, the plants struggle against each other for sunlight, air, and soil food, leading to thin stems and small grain yields.
ga: Kɛji adu ŋmãa dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ tsɔ Tsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la, kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ feɔ mlɛo ni amɛwoɔ ŋmãa bibii.

english: Cassava roots rot when trapped water stays around them for too long. Planting cassava on raised soil mounds or ridges allows water to drain away quickly so the roots stay healthy.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu ŋmɛ amɛhe be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ. Kɛ́ adu ŋmei yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ko ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ, ehaa nu lɛ hoɔ oya. Shishifãi lɛ wa.

english: Lifting yam leaves up on tall stakes allows them to capture more sunlight, which gives the plant the energy it needs to build large tubers underground.
ga: Kɛ́ awó sweet potato baai lɛ anɔ yɛ tsei ni kwɔlɔ anɔ lɛ, ehaa amɛnáa hulu la babaoo. Enɛ haa tso lɛ náa hewalɛ ni he hiaa lɛ koni ekɛwo shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii wuji.

english: Why should I cut off extra shoots growing at the bottom of my plantain tree?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafolɔ ŋmeii ni fa fe nine ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ dumɔwu ko shishi lɛ?

english: Removing extra shoots—called suckers—ensures that soil nutrients and water go directly to the main plant, helping it grow a bigger and heavier bunch.
ga: Ajieɔ ŋmeii ni fa fe nine ni atsɛɔ lɛ ŋmeii Enɛ baaha niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ nu mli lɛ aya tso titri lɛ tɛ̃ɛ. Eyeɔ ebuaa tsei lɛ ni amɛdaraa ni amɛfeɔ ŋmeii wuji ni tsii.
